summary: Abbott's record spans over a decade of unqualified pro-Israel statements, from calling Ariel Sharon "a giant leader" in 2014 to applauding Trump's Jerusalem recognition in 2017. In 2025 he threatened to defund San Marcos, TX over a proposed Gaza ceasefire resolution, labeling it "antisemitic." In 2024 he directed Texas higher-education institutions to define antisemitism in free-speech policies while citing the state's boycott-Israel ban, and in 2026 he urged the AG to revoke CAIR Texas's nonprofit status.
